title: Review: ship orders with a notification
summary: A small PR that notifies the customer when an order ships, with four review findings anchored to its lines.

blocks.title: Ship orders with a notification
blocks.head: feature/notify-shipped
blocks.diff:
diff --git a/src/orders/ship.ts b/src/orders/ship.ts
index 3f2a1c4..8b7d9e0 100644
--- a/src/orders/ship.ts
+++ b/src/orders/ship.ts
@@ -1,9 +1,13 @@
 import { db } from '../db.ts'
+import { notifyShipped } from './notify.ts'
 import type { Order } from './types.ts'
 
-export async function markShipped(id: number): Promise<Order> {
-  const order = await db.orders.find(id)
-  order.status = 'shipped'
-  await db.orders.save(order)
+export async function markShipped(id: number, carrier?: string): Promise<Order> {
+  const order = await db.orders.find(id)
+  if (order.status === 'shipped') return order
+  order.status = 'shipped'
+  order.carrier = carrier ?? 'unknown'
+  await db.orders.save(order)
+  await notifyShipped(order)
   return order
 }
@@ -30,4 +35,5 @@
 
 export async function cancel(id: number): Promise<void> {
-  await db.orders.delete(id)
+  const order = await db.orders.find(id)
+  await db.orders.save({ ...order, status: 'cancelled' })
 }
diff --git a/src/orders/notify.ts b/src/orders/notify.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..c41e5aa
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/orders/notify.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+import { mailer } from '../mailer.ts'
+import type { Order } from './types.ts'
+
+// Sends the shipping email; failures are logged, never thrown.
+export async function notifyShipped(order: Order): Promise<void> {
+  try {
+    await mailer.send(order.email, `Order ${order.id} shipped via ${order.carrier}`)
+  } catch (e) {
+    console.log('notify failed', e)
+  }
+}

findings.title: The notification failure is swallowed
findings.summary: A failed email is logged with console.log and dropped.
findings.detail: The order is already saved as shipped, so throwing would be wrong, but nothing retries and nothing alerts. Use the shared logger at `error` level and enqueue a retry.

findings.title: The early return skips the notification
findings.summary: A second call returns before notifying; correct, but a first call that failed to notify is never retried here.
findings.detail: If the first call saved the order and then failed inside `notifyShipped`, calling `markShipped` again is a no-op. That ties back to the swallowed failure.

findings.title: The old cancel deleted the row
findings.summary: Cancel used to delete; it now keeps the row, so queries that count orders include cancelled ones.
findings.detail: Reports that read `db.orders` without a status filter will change. Worth a line in the PR description.
warnings: No test covers the report queries.

findings.title: The runbook now names a log line
findings.summary: The runbook tells operators what to search for; keep the wording in sync with the log message.
